payload.name: Finom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finom is a business finance platform for SMEs and freelancers across Europe, combining a business account, invoicing, expense management, and accounting in one place.

This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Finom business data. Ask about transactions and spending across your accounts, look up invoices and payment status, review card activity, and check bookkeeping records and tax deadlines.

You need an active Finom account to use this connector. Access is limited to the companies your account is authorized for, and you approve access through Finom’s standard sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
Finom 是面向欧洲中小企业和自由职业者的企业财务平台，将企业账户、开票、费用管理和会计整合于一处。

此连接器让 ChatGPT 访问你的 Finom 企业数据。可以询问各账户的交易及支出，查询发票和付款状态，查看银行卡交易活动，并检查记账记录和税务截止日期。

使用此连接器需要有效的 Finom 账户。访问仅限于该账户获授权的公司，你通过 Finom 的标准登录流程批准访问。

payload.name: StackerScan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StackerScan gives ChatGPT live precious-metals market data through five read-only tools.

Current and previous-session spot prices for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper and nickel, in any supported currency and per troy ounce or gram. Rolling fine-metal-weighted median asking premiums over spot, observed from real marketplace listings rather than quoted by a dealer. Daily historical series for charting — one metal, the Goldback, or one PCGS-numbered coin at one grade. The latest Goldback premium multiple over its gold content, and the exchange rate that follows from it. And the live list of currency codes every request accepts — ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes.

No API key, account, or registration is required. StackerScan is not a dealer and sells no bullion; do not use it to buy or sell metal. Numismatic valuation is only available for coins with a PCGS number. Results are structured JSON mirroring the open HTTP API documented at https://www.stackerscan.com/openapi.json.
payload.longDescription:
StackerScan 通过五个只读工具向 ChatGPT 提供实时贵金属市场数据。

获取黄金、白银、铂金、钯金、铜和镍的当前及上一交易时段现货价格，以任意支持的货币显示，单位为金衡盎司或克。获取按纯金属重量加权、相对现货价格的滚动报价溢价中位数，数据来自真实市场挂牌，而非经销商报价。获取用于绘图的每日历史序列——可选择一种金属、Goldback，或某一品相等级下具有 PCGS 编号的一枚钱币。获取 Goldback 相对其含金量的最新溢价倍数及由此推导的汇率。还可获取各请求当前接受的货币代码列表——包括 ISO 4217 法定货币、BTC 和金属代码。

无需 API 密钥、账户或注册。StackerScan 不是经销商，也不出售金银条块；请勿用它买卖金属。钱币收藏价值评估仅适用于具有 PCGS 编号的钱币。结果为结构化 JSON，与 https://www.stackerscan.com/openapi.json 所载公开 HTTP API 一致。

payload.name: Vings
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vings lets authenticated users inspect their own financial data through ChatGPT, including transactions, cashflow, spending categories, merchants, recurring payments, budgets, connected bank status, portfolio snapshots, portfolio history, and preferences.

payload.name: FinOpps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get instant answers about upcoming work, revenue, customer payments, and business performance from your FinOpps account.
payload.longDescription: 从 FinOpps 账户即时获取有关即将开展的工作、收入、客户付款和业务表现的答案。

payload.name: OnePro AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e
aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.

Consulta de ativos: fichas completas de ETFs brasileiros e globais, ações, BDRs,
FIIs, fundos CVM, debêntures, renda fixa pública e privada e índices,  custos,
patrimônio líquido, retornos históricos, alocação e composição. Screener com
filtros por classe, look-through da carteira de ETFs (inclusive ETFs de ETFs) e
lookup reverso ("quais ETFs carregam NVDA?").

Análise de carteira: seus portfólios salvos no OnePro, ou uma carteira informada
na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,
IFIX, IMA-B e S&P 500. Inclui ranking entre carteiras, consistência em janelas
móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

Motores de simulação: fronteira eficiente e carteira de máximo Sharpe;
probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

Todos os resultados vêm de um snapshot diário de dados, com a versão do dado
declarada em cada resposta, e os motores raciocinam em termos reais (R$ de hoje e dólar).
O conector é somente leitura: nenhuma operação altera dados da sua conta, e
nenhuma ordem de compra ou venda é executada. As análises são informativas e não
constituem recomendação de investimento.

Requer assinatura ativa do OnePro em etf1.com.br.
payload.longDescription:
OnePro 将您的 ETF1 账户连接到 ChatGPT，让您访问与平台中使用的相同数据库和分析引擎。

资产查询：提供巴西和全球 ETF、股票、巴西存托凭证（BDR）、房地产投资基金（FII）、CVM 基金、公司债券、公私部门固定收益产品及指数的完整资料，包括费用、净资产、历史收益、资产配置和组成。支持按资产类别筛选、穿透分析 ETF 投资组合（包括投资 ETF 的 ETF），以及反向查询（“哪些 ETF 持有 NVDA？”）。

投资组合分析：根据收益、波动率、夏普比率、索提诺比率、最大回撤、恢复时间和相关性，评估您保存在 OnePro 中的组合，或在对话中提供的组合，并与 CDI、IBOV、IFIX、IMA-B 和 S&P 500 等基准比较。包括组合排名、10 年滚动窗口的一致性，以及按起始年份展示实际复合年增长率（CAGR）的热力图。

模拟引擎：有效前沿和最大夏普比率组合；达到资产目标的概率（目标导向投资）；通过蒙特卡洛模拟预测未来资产；以及退休提款计划，包含安全提款率（SWR）、永久提款率（PWR），以及传统、再平衡、分桶和带有护栏机制的动态支出策略。

所有结果均来自每日数据快照，每次回答均注明数据版本；引擎以实际购买力计算（按今日价值计的 R$ 和美元）。连接器仅提供只读访问：任何操作都不会更改账户数据，也不会执行买入或卖出订单。分析仅供参考，不构成投资建议。

需要在 etf1.com.br 上拥有有效的 OnePro 订阅。

payload.name: FinPilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: O FinPilot ajuda o usuário a consultar contas, cartões, lançamentos e saldos da sua planilha financeira pessoal pelo ChatGPT. Também permite validar, criar, atualizar, replicar, marcar, excluir e desfazer lançamentos mediante as permissões concedidas no OAuth. O app registra somente as informações fornecidas pelo usuário, não acessa bancos, não usa Open Finance e não movimenta dinheiro.
payload.longDescription: FinPilot 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查询个人财务电子表格中的账户、卡片、账目记录和余额。它还允许按照 OAuth 中授予的权限，对账目记录进行验证、创建、更新、复制、标记、删除和撤销。应用仅记录用户提供的信息，不访问银行，不使用 Open Finance，也不转移资金。

payload.name: Sumline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sumline helps real estate professionals get reliable property numbers inside ChatGPT without having to teach the AI how to calculate each scenario. Ask naturally about seller net proceeds, buyer cash to close and monthly housing costs, rental property returns, or fixed-rate mortgage payments. Sumline runs the same deterministic calculation engines used by the Sumline web app and returns the verified figures, assumptions, warnings, and a link to continue the scenario in Sumline. Sumline does not determine loan qualification or affordability and does not provide legal, tax, lending, appraisal, or investment advice.
payload.longDescription: Sumline 帮助房地产专业人士在 ChatGPT 中获取可靠的房产数字，无需教 AI 如何计算每种情景。用自然语言询问卖方净收益、买方交割所需现金和每月住房成本、出租房产回报或固定利率按揭付款。Sumline 运行与 Sumline 网页应用相同的确定性计算引擎，返回经核验的数字、假设、警告，以及在 Sumline 中继续该情景的链接。Sumline 不判定贷款资格或负担能力，也不提供法律、税务、贷款、估价或投资建议。

payload.name: Bound MCP
payload.description: 读取 Bound API 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bound MCP helps users inspect Bound account balances, payment recipients, payments, FX orders, indicative exchange rates, and upcoming settlements through read-only Public API tools.
payload.longDescription: Bound MCP 通过只读 Public API 工具，帮助用户查看 Bound 账户余额、付款收款人、付款、外汇订单、参考汇率和即将进行的结算。

payload.name: Atominvest
payload.description: 直接查询 Atominvest 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Atominvest platform to query Portfolio Management or Investor Management data, including portfolio company metrics, investor data, and fund commitments, directly from your conversation. Retrieve financial KPIs such as revenue, EBITDA, and debt for portfolio assets across any reporting period, look up investor accounts and their associated entities, and get detailed commitment breakdowns across funds, including amounts and statuses, all without leaving ChatGPT. Ideal for portfolio managers and investor relations teams who need fast, conversational access to their Atominvest data to support reporting, investor queries, and portfolio monitoring.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Atominvest 平台，直接在对话中查询投资组合管理或投资者管理数据，包括被投公司指标、投资者数据和基金认缴承诺。获取任意报告期间内投资组合资产的收入、EBITDA 和债务等财务关键绩效指标，查询投资者账户及其关联实体，并获取各基金认缴承诺的详细明细，包括金额和状态，全程无需离开 ChatGPT。适合需要通过快速对话访问 Atominvest 数据，以支持报告、投资者问询和投资组合监测的投资组合经理及投资者关系团队。

payload.name: Parallel
payload.description: 访问 Parallel 财务数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Parallel financial plan to Claude, ChatGPT, and any other MCP-compatible assistant. Ask questions about your model in plain language and get grounded, real-time answers pulled straight from your live data, with no exporting, no copy-paste, and no stale spreadsheets.

The server exposes Parallel's core planning surface as a set of tools: query your P&L, revenue and expense forecasts, headcount and hiring plans, monthly reports, and the assumptions driving your model. Your assistant can pull the exact numbers it needs to answer a question, compare scenarios, or summarize where the business is headed.

Access is read-only and secured with OAuth. Your assistant can explore and report on your financials but never modify them. You connect once, scope what it can see, and revoke access any time.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 Parallel 财务计划连接到 Claude、ChatGPT 以及任何兼容 MCP 的助手。用日常语言询问模型，即可直接从实时数据获取有依据的即时答案，无需导出、复制粘贴或使用过时的电子表格。

服务器将 Parallel 的核心规划功能开放为一组工具：查询损益表（P&L）、收入与费用预测、人员编制和招聘计划、月度报告，以及驱动模型的假设。助手可以提取回答问题所需的准确数字、比较情景或概括企业的发展方向。

访问为只读，并通过 OAuth 保护。助手可以探索和报告你的财务数据，但绝不能修改。只需连接一次，即可限定可见范围，并随时撤销访问。

payload.name: AIR Credit Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AIR Credit combines powerful machine learning credit intelligence with AI agents directly inside ChatGPT. Instantly assess companies, uncover emerging credit risks before they become obvious, understand the drivers behind every rating, and test future scenarios in seconds. Whether you're evaluating counterparties, investments, suppliers, or borrowers, AIR helps you make faster, more informed decisions without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: AIR Credit 将强大的机器学习信用情报与 AI 智能体结合，直接带入 ChatGPT。即时评估公司，在新兴信用风险明显显现前发现它们，理解每个评级背后的驱动因素，并在几秒内测试未来情景。无论评估交易对手、投资、供应商还是借款人，AIR 都能帮助你在不离开对话的情况下更快作出更有依据的决策。

payload.name: Laabam.One
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read your invoices, cash position and P&L — and draft new customers, invoices and bulk price updates for you to approve inside Laabam.One.
payload.longDescription: 读取你的发票、现金头寸及损益，并起草新客户资料、发票及批量价格更新，供你在 Laabam.One 内批准。
payload.developer: Laabam One Business Solutions (OPC) Private Limited

information.label: Developer

payload.name: LedgerLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LedgerLens turns your transactions and uploaded bank statements into a conversation. Ask about recent purchases,  category spending, or specific merchants and get instant answers grounded in your own data. 
Upload statements once, then explore your finances by simply asking — no dashboards to navigate, no filters to configure. Your data stays in LedgerLens; ChatGPT reads it only during active tool calls through a secure OAuth connection you control.
payload.longDescription:
LedgerLens 将你的交易和上传的银行对账单转化为对话。询问近期购买、各类别支出或特定商户，即可立即获得基于你自身数据的答案。
只需上传一次对账单，之后提问即可探索财务状况，无需浏览仪表板，也无需配置筛选条件。数据保留在 LedgerLens 中；ChatGPT 仅在实际工具调用期间，通过由你控制的安全 OAuth 连接读取数据。

payload.name: Cryptoworth
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cryptoworth lets ChatGPT read authorized Cryptoworth crypto-accounting portfolio data through 20 read-only tools. Users can inspect authorized portfolios, ledger transactions, connections and wallets, balance snapshots, DeFi positions, NFT holdings and activity, transaction labels, invoices, bills, and supported asset reference data. The app is read-only: it does not create, edit, delete, sync, recalculate, trade, transfer funds, sign transactions, or initiate payments.
payload.longDescription: Cryptoworth 通过 20 个只读工具，让 ChatGPT 读取已获授权的 Cryptoworth 加密资产会计投资组合数据。用户可查看获授权的投资组合、总账交易、连接和钱包、余额快照、DeFi 持仓、NFT 持有资产及活动、交易标签、发票、账单，以及支持的资产参考数据。应用仅供只读：不创建、编辑、删除、同步、重新计算、交易、转移资金、签署交易或发起付款。

payload.name: Chargebee (AU Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Chargebee 中的实时订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出账单问题，即可立即获取答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷项通知单缺漏、按计费周期划分的 LTV，以及试用转化情况。

这些交叉关联能够实现，是因为 Chargebee 在一个相互连接的数据模型中保存完整的商业事件链，包括付款事件、套餐变化、发票记录和取消原因，全部互相关联，并带有时间戳。

payload.name: Lexfi
payload.description: 面向 AI 的金融数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lexfi gives ChatGPT access to structured financial data for research and analysis. It covers equities, macroeconomics, fixed income, institutional holdings, market sentiment, alternative data, and global markets through a unified MCP connection. Users can retrieve market data, company information, economic indicators, ownership activity, and financial signals directly in conversation. Lexfi is a financial data provider and does not execute trades or provide investment advice.
payload.longDescription: Lexfi 为 ChatGPT 提供结构化金融数据，供研究和分析使用。通过统一的 MCP 连接，覆盖股票、宏观经济、固定收益、机构持仓、市场情绪、另类数据和全球市场。用户可直接在对话中获取市场数据、公司信息、经济指标、所有权变动和金融信号。Lexfi 是金融数据提供商，不执行交易，也不提供投资建议。

payload.name: IFG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
IFG brings official tax sources into ChatGPT for tax advisers, tax lawyers, accountants and in-house tax teams.

Research legislation, administrative guidance, case law, tax treaties, EU law and OECD publications across the jurisdictions available in IFG. Find a source from a citation or topic, browse a code or treaty, and open the relevant provision with its official publisher link.

Check available text versions and applicability information for a specified date. Read treaty provisions and their tax-effect dates, locate passages in long documents, and retrieve published legal changes. Use the cited sources to support research notes, client work and internal tax analysis.

Coverage, historical depth and applicability evidence vary by source and jurisdiction. IFG identifies missing evidence and partial results so professionals can assess the limits of each source.
payload.longDescription:
IFG 将官方税务资料带入 ChatGPT，服务于税务顾问、税务律师、会计师及企业内部税务团队。

研究 IFG 所覆盖司法辖区的立法、行政指引、判例法、税收协定、欧盟法律及 OECD 出版物。根据引用或主题查找来源、浏览法典或协定，并打开相关条文及其官方发布方链接。

查看指定日期可用的文本版本及适用性信息。阅读协定条款及其税务生效日期，在长文档中定位段落，并检索已公布的法律变更。使用引用来源支持研究笔记、客户工作及内部税务分析。

覆盖范围、历史资料深度及适用性证据因来源和司法辖区而异。IFG 会标明证据缺失和不完整结果，供专业人士判断各来源的局限。

payload.name: airpay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your airpay account to access payment data through conversation. Ask ChatGPT about transactions, settlements, refunds, etc. and get instant answers without logging into your dashboard.
What you can do:
1. Retrieve transaction and order details
2. Check settlement and refund status
3. View payment analytics by date, method, or geography
4. and more.
payload.longDescription:
连接 airpay 账户，通过对话访问支付数据。向 ChatGPT 询问交易、结算、退款等情况，无需登录面板即可立即获得答案。
你可以：
1. 获取交易和订单详情
2. 查看结算与退款状态
3. 按日期、方式或地区查看支付分析
4. 以及更多功能。

payload.name: Lassie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lassie helps pet owners explore insurance quotes for dogs and cats in supported countries, confirm collected pet details, compare factual plan information, adjust quote options, and answer questions about Lassie coverage and policy terms.
payload.longDescription: Lassie 帮助宠物主人在支持的国家了解狗和猫的保险报价、确认已收集的宠物信息、比较客观方案信息、调整报价选项，并解答有关 Lassie 保障和保单条款的问题。

payload.name: HourProof
payload.description: 记录出租业务参与工时
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HourProof helps short-term and long-term rental owners keep contemporaneous material-participation records for tax purposes. Through ChatGPT, users log property-management activities as they happen ("log 90 minutes of turnover cleaning at Beach House yesterday"), review their activity log with date, property, and category filters, check year-to-date hours against their material-participation goals (100 hours for STR, 750 for LTR) with on-pace status, and cross-reference synced guest reservations when reconstructing work performed. Activities logged through ChatGPT are labeled as agent-logged in the user's audit trail and sync to the HourProof mobile app.
payload.longDescription: HourProof 帮助短租和长租业主为税务用途及时保存实质参与记录。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以记录发生的物业管理活动（“记录昨天在 Beach House 进行的 90 分钟换客清洁”），按日期、房产和类别筛选查看活动日志，将年初至今的工时与实质参与目标（短租 STR 为 100 小时，长租 LTR 为 750 小时）比较并查看进度是否达标，以及在回溯已完成工作时交叉核对同步的客人预订。通过 ChatGPT 记录的活动会在用户审计记录中标记为智能体记录，并同步至 HourProof 移动应用。

payload.name: CredCore - Tusk Liquid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tusk Liquid connects AI assistants to CredCore's curated database of public credit-agreement data — covenants, debt structure, pricing, amendments, and obligations — extracted from publicly filed credit agreements. Once connected, you can query a deal's terms, benchmark covenant packages against market comps, track changes across amendments, and compare a borrower with its peers; the assistant retrieves the values and composes the answer. Coverage spans thousands of agreements across sectors, structures, and lenders. Built for leveraged-finance, private-credit, CLO, DCM, and legal teams. Read-only and informational only — not legal, lending, investment, or underwriting advice.
payload.longDescription: Tusk Liquid 将 AI 助手连接到 CredCore 精选的公开信贷协议数据库，其中包含从公开提交的信贷协议中提取的契约条款、债务结构、定价、修订和义务。连接后，您可查询交易条款、对照市场可比交易评估契约条款组合、跟踪各次修订的变化，并将借款人与同业比较；助手会提取相应数值并组织答案。覆盖不同行业、结构及贷款人的数千份协议。面向杠杆融资、私募信贷、CLO、债务资本市场（DCM）及法务团队。仅提供只读访问，且仅供参考——不构成法律、贷款、投资或承销建议。

payload.name: Secfi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan and understand your equity compensation with Secfi. Get answers on your portfolio valuations, exercise costs, AMT exposure and model exit scenarios - all calculated from your actual equity data. Weather you’re trying to decide when to exercise or stress-testing potential exit outcomes, the analysis comes to you from Secfi’s calculation APIs.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Secfi 规划和了解股权薪酬。获取投资组合估值、行权成本、替代性最低税（AMT）风险敞口及退出情景建模的答案，全部根据实际股权数据计算。无论是决定何时行权，还是对潜在退出结果进行压力测试，分析均来自 Secfi 的计算 API。

payload.name: Vaatun
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vaatun is your assistant for modern Insurtech: the AI-native platform helping insurance brokers, MGAs, and intermediaries run and grow their business. Ask about broker CRMs, policy and claims automation, employee-benefits portals, and embedded distribution, and get straight answers plus side-by-side comparisons of Vaatun against tools like Saiba, Zoho, Sibro and IMTCare. Explore Vaatun's products (Vantage, Advantage, and Quik), read the latest Insurtech insights from the Vaatun blog, meet the team, and book a demo or trial without leaving the chat. Built for anyone evaluating how to digitize and scale an insurance intermediary business.

payload.name: FactIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FactIQ is a research data layer for AI agents. It gives users access to source-linked economic, market and company intelligence—including official statistics, structured company financials, filings and earnings-call evidence—inside tools such as ChatGPT and Codex.
payload.longDescription: FactIQ 是面向 AI 智能体的研究数据层。它让用户在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 等工具中访问关联来源的经济、市场和公司情报，包括官方统计、结构化公司财务数据、申报文件及财报电话会议证据。

payload.name: FX Hedge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FX Hedge brings C8's quantitative currency-hedging models into ChatGPT. Ask for the current hedge ratio between your base currency and any exposure - for example "my base is EUR, what's my hedge against USD?" - and get the model's ratio, the four signal drivers behind it (macro, trend, carry, value), and a detailed month-by-month breakdown with live ECB reference rates.

FX Hedge is decision support for treasury and investment teams. It provides analytics only: it does not give investment advice, make recommendations, or execute transactions. A C8 FX Hedge subscription is required; you sign in with your subscription email and a one-time code - no API keys.
payload.longDescription:
FX Hedge 将 C8 的量化货币对冲模型带入 ChatGPT。询问本位币与任意风险敞口之间的当前对冲比例，例如“我的本位币是 EUR，应如何对冲 USD？”即可获得模型给出的比例、背后的四类信号驱动因素（宏观、趋势、利差收益、价值），以及包含实时 ECB 参考汇率的逐月详细分解。

FX Hedge 为资金管理及投资团队提供决策支持。它仅提供分析，不提供投资意见、不作推荐，也不执行交易。需要订阅 C8 FX Hedge；使用订阅邮箱和一次性验证码登录，无需 API 密钥。

payload.name: wlthy
payload.description: Track net worth and cash flow
payload.summaryOriginal: Track net worth and cash flow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: wlthy is a net worth tracker for cross-border wealth. See your full portfolio, debts, and multi-currency cash flows across countries in one place, in any of 13 currencies. Import broker and bank statements, then break down allocation by asset class, loan-to-value, and FX exposure. Informational tracking only, not investment, tax or legal advice. wlthy never moves money or trades on your behalf.

payload.name: Yoshi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yoshi brings your personal financial context into ChatGPT. Connect your accounts to get detailed visibility across balances, transactions, holdings, liabilities, and account activity in one place.

Ask questions about any account, transaction, or investment, and get detailed answers grounded in your own financial data. You can also set up agents to monitor changes, keep tabs on specific parts of your finances, and generate reports whenever you need them. Yoshi helps turn ChatGPT into a context-aware financial assistant built around your financial life.

payload.name: Lightsplit
payload.description: 在聊天中分摊团体费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lightsplit is a shared group ledger designed for trips, households, and teams, managed entirely through conversation. Easily create groups and share access via Web, LINE, or Telegram. Track expenses, income, and settlements with equal, weighted, or custom splits across multiple currencies. Attach receipts, optimize debt settlements with minimal transfers, manage shared to-do lists, set budgets, and view category-by-category spending breakdowns effortlessly.
payload.longDescription: Lightsplit 是为旅行、家庭和团队设计的共享团体账本，完全通过对话管理。轻松创建群组，并通过 Web、LINE 或 Telegram 共享访问。支持多种货币，以均等、加权或自定义方式分摊，记录费用、收入和结算。附加收据，以最少转账次数优化债务结算，管理共享待办清单，设定预算，并轻松查看各类别的支出明细。

payload.name: OptimalCover
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OptimalCover is an independent pricing transparency tool for Vehicle Service Contracts (VSCs), often called extended warranties. It helps consumers assess whether pricing they encounter is reasonable by comparing it to independent, fair-market benchmarks derived from real data.

Unlike dealerships or warranty providers, OptimalCover has no incentive to sell, upsell, or recommend coverage. It exists to provide clarity in an industry known for complexity and inconsistent pricing, so you can make informed decisions with confidence.

No pressure. No pitches. Just honest pricing insight.
payload.longDescription:
OptimalCover 是针对车辆服务合同（VSC，通常称为延长保修）的独立价格透明度工具。它将消费者遇到的报价与从真实数据得出的独立、公平市场基准比较，帮助判断价格是否合理。

与汽车经销商或保修提供商不同，OptimalCover 没有销售、追加销售或推荐保障的利益动机。它旨在为一个以复杂性和定价不一致著称的行业提供清晰信息，让你有信心作出知情决策。

没有施压，没有推销，只有诚实的价格洞察。

payload.name: Fitch Solutions
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access trusted Fitch Ratings credit research and data, CreditSights intelligence, and BMI country and sector risk analysis — all through a single, governed MCP connection. Query ratings, financials, key rating drivers, research, and deal insights directly inside your AI workflows. Built for regulated environments with enterprise-grade authentication and entitlement controls. Fitch intelligence, where you work.
payload.longDescription: 通过一个具有治理控制的 MCP 连接，获取可信赖的 Fitch Ratings 信用研究及数据、CreditSights 情报，以及 BMI 国家和行业风险分析。直接在 AI 工作流中查询评级、财务数据、关键评级驱动因素、研究和交易洞察。专为受监管环境构建，提供企业级身份验证和授权控制。在你的工作场景中使用 Fitch 情报。

payload.name: RoboSystems
payload.description: SEC 披露文件知识图谱
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RoboSystems turns public-company financial filings into a knowledge graph ChatGPT can query directly.

SEC EDGAR: every public company's XBRL filings as one queryable graph. Pull a company's financial statements by ticker or CIK, pivot reported facts across companies, periods and dimensions, resolve a concept like "revenue" to its XBRL element, and run full-text search across filing narratives, then read the exact section.

Read a filing the way it was filed: list the statements and notes in a 10-K or 10-Q, then open one section whole, with its rows, breakdowns and the calculations that tie it together.

The graph also exposes read-only Cypher, so a conversation can move from a question ("show me NVIDIA's latest income statement") to a raw traversal ("which 2025 10-Ks mention goodwill impairment?") without leaving ChatGPT.

Authorization is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. This plugin connects only to the SEC EDGAR repository, which is read-only, and you can revoke access at any time. Open source (Apache-2.0): github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems
payload.longDescription:
RoboSystems 将上市公司的财务披露文件转化为 ChatGPT 可以直接查询的知识图谱。

SEC EDGAR：将每家上市公司的 XBRL 披露文件整合成一个可查询图谱。按股票代码或 CIK 获取公司的财务报表，对不同公司、期间和维度的已报告数据进行透视分析，将“收入”等概念对应到其 XBRL 元素，并在披露文件的文字叙述中进行全文搜索，然后阅读准确的对应章节。

按文件原始披露形式阅读：列出 10-K 或 10-Q 中的报表和附注，然后打开完整章节，查看其各行数据、明细及相互勾稽的计算关系。

该图谱还提供只读 Cypher，使对话能够从一个问题（“给我看看 NVIDIA 最新的利润表”）转向原始图遍历查询（“哪些 2025 年的 10-K 提到了商誉减值？”），无需离开 ChatGPT。

授权采用带 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1。此插件仅连接只读的 SEC EDGAR 资料库，你可以随时撤销访问权限。开源（Apache-2.0）：github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems

payload.name: Rootline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rootline is a European payment service provider for platforms and marketplaces. This Model Context Protocol server connects your Rootline account to ChatGPT, so you can ask about any payment, merchant account, or settlement across your network.
payload.longDescription: Rootline 是面向平台和市场的欧洲支付服务提供商。此模型上下文协议服务器将你的 Rootline 账户连接到 ChatGPT，让你查询整个网络中的任何支付、商户账户或结算。

payload.name: Rillet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rillet helps finance teams retrieve financial data and manage accounting records, including invoices, bills, customers, vendors, journal entries, bank activity, contracts, and financial reports.
payload.longDescription: Rillet 帮助财务团队获取财务数据并管理会计记录，包括销售发票、应付账单、客户、供应商、会计分录、银行活动、合同及财务报告。

payload.name: Embat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query your cash, debt, treasury forecasts, accounting, PSP reconciliations, payments, and intercompany positions in plain language — answered with your real numbers from Embat. TellMe inherits your existing permissions, so every reply is scoped to what you can already see. Make your treasury management system a native part of your AI workflow, without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 用日常语言查询现金、债务、资金预测、会计、支付服务提供商（PSP）对账、支付及公司间头寸——答案使用您在 Embat 中的真实数字。TellMe 继承您现有的权限，因此每个回答都限于您本来就可查看的内容。让资金管理系统自然融入 AI 工作流程，无需离开对话。

payload.name: Theia Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into ChatGPT. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.

The data is built on the Theia Insights Industry Classification (TIIC): a five-level, one-to-many taxonomy mapping companies to 3,000+ investable themes based on what they actually do. Performance is tracked through Theme Watch Indices (TWI), with 10+ years of daily history across global regions.

What you can do in ChatGPT:

* Profile any company by ticker, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker — see its full thematic exposure from sector down to micro-theme.
* Screen for thematic exposure across public markets — find the companies most exposed to a given theme, sub-industry, or industry.
* Benchmark theme performance over time and rank themes by recent returns to identify leaders, laggards, and rotation trends.

Built for portfolio managers, research analysts, index providers, and allocators who need defensible, data-driven answers to thematic questions.

payload.name: Alpaca Paper Trading
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to paper trading execution via Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API. 

Connect ChatGPT to your Alpaca paper account to place simulated trades across stocks, ETFs, options, and crypto. Monitor your positions, analyze market trends, and manage your account through natural language.

Insights generated by Alpaca’s MCP server, ChatGPT plugin and connected AI agents are for educational and informational use only and not investment advice. Do your own due diligence before making decisions.

AlpacaDB, Inc.’s Paper Trading API uses simulated funds and does not enable transactions in real securities. Its availability and content do not constitute an offer, solicitation, investment advice, recommendation, or endorsement involving securities, derivatives, futures, or trading strategies. The API is not offered in jurisdictions where AlpacaDB, Inc. or its affiliates (collectively, “Alpaca”) are not authorized to conduct business.

Options trading is not suitable for all investors due to its inherent high risk, which can potentially result in significant losses. Please read Characteristics and Risks of Standardized Options (https://www.theocc.com/Company-Information/Documents-and-Archives/Options-Disclosure-Document) before investing in options.

Please see the Disclosure Library at https://alpaca.markets/disclosures for additional information and disclosures from Alpaca Clearing and Alpaca Crypto.
payload.longDescription:
Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件通过 Alpaca 的 Trading API 和 Market Data API，直接提供模拟交易执行功能。

将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Alpaca 模拟账户，即可对股票、ETF、期权和加密资产下达模拟交易指令。通过自然语言监控持仓、分析市场趋势并管理账户。

Alpaca 的 MCP 服务器、ChatGPT 插件及连接的 AI 智能体生成的见解仅用于教育和信息参考，不构成投资建议。作出决定前，请自行进行尽职调查。

AlpacaDB, Inc. 的 Paper Trading API 使用模拟资金，不能进行真实证券交易。其可用性及内容不构成涉及证券、衍生品、期货或交易策略的要约、招揽、投资建议、推荐或背书。在 AlpacaDB, Inc. 或其关联公司（合称“Alpaca”）未获准开展业务的司法辖区，不提供该 API。

期权交易本身风险较高，可能造成重大损失，因此并不适合所有投资者。投资期权前，请阅读《标准化期权的特征与风险》（https://www.theocc.com/Company-Information/Documents-and-Archives/Options-Disclosure-Document）。

有关 Alpaca Clearing 和 Alpaca Crypto 的更多信息及披露，请参阅 https://alpaca.markets/disclosures 的披露资料库。

payload.name: Menz Finance
payload.description: 获授权的个人与企业财务管理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Consulte relatórios, lançamentos, contas, vendas, estoque e precificação, e registre operações financeiras dentro do Menz Finance. O plugin não movimenta dinheiro nem executa pagamentos externos.
payload.longDescription: 在 Menz Finance 中查询报告、账目分录、账户、销售、库存和定价，并记录财务操作。插件不转移资金，也不执行外部付款。

payload.name: B2B.nu
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中处理瑞典会计事务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
B2B.nu is a Swedish ERP for small businesses: invoicing, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, VAT, payroll and CRM. This app connects ChatGPT to the user's own B2B.nu company so they can ask questions in plain Swedish and get answers from live data — the current financial position, the income statement and balance sheet, the VAT basis for the next filing, which invoices are overdue, which costs have drifted, and what is due next.

With write access explicitly granted, it can create and post records: invoice drafts, customer payments, journal entries, supplier invoices, bank reconciliations and to-dos. Financial actions may create bookkeeping entries and update related invoice, expense or bank-transaction statuses. The app never transfers money, sends invoices automatically or deletes records; corrections are made by the user in B2B.nu.

Access is controlled by OAuth 2.1. The user picks which company to connect and which areas to share, and every tool is additionally checked against their own permissions in B2B.nu — the AI can never do more than the user can. Personal identity numbers, bank account numbers and bankgiro/IBAN details are never returned by any tool.
payload.longDescription:
B2B.nu 是面向小企业的瑞典 ERP，涵盖开票、记账、银行对账、增值税、薪资和 CRM。此应用将 ChatGPT 连接到用户自己的 B2B.nu 公司，让用户以普通瑞典语提问，并根据实时数据获得答案——包括当前财务状况、利润表和资产负债表、下次申报的增值税计税依据、哪些发票已逾期、哪些成本出现偏离，以及接下来有哪些到期事项。

在明确授予写入权限后，它可以创建和过账记录：发票草稿、客户付款、会计分录、供应商发票、银行对账和待办事项。财务操作可能生成记账分录，并更新相关发票、费用或银行交易的状态。应用绝不会转移资金、自动发送发票或删除记录；更正由用户在 B2B.nu 中完成。

访问由 OAuth 2.1 控制。用户选择要连接的公司和要共享的领域，每个工具还会根据用户在 B2B.nu 中的自身权限进行额外检查——AI 的操作范围绝不会超出用户本人。任何工具都不会返回个人身份号码、银行账号或 bankgiro/IBAN 信息。

payload.name: AgentCollect
payload.description: 查询应收账款组合的任何问题
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AgentCollect connects your AR recovery data to your assistant. Ask "how much did we recover last quarter?", "what's my recovery rate?", or "which accounts paid the most?" and get a complete, business-framed answer scoped strictly to your own account. Read-only, OAuth-secured, no write access.
payload.longDescription: AgentCollect 将您的应收账款（AR）回收数据连接到助手。询问“我们上个季度收回了多少钱？”、“我的回收率是多少？”或“哪些账户支付最多？”，即可获得完整、以业务为背景且严格限于您自己账户的答案。仅提供只读访问，通过 OAuth 保护，不具备写入权限。

payload.name: Bizora Tax Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bizora is an AI native tax research platform. This connector brings Bizora’s research engine into ChatGPT, so you can ask a tax question in the middle of your actual work and get an answer grounded in primary source authority rather than secondary commentary.

Ask the question the way you would ask a colleague. Bizora interprets it, researches it against the governing authority, and returns a reasoned answer with citations you can open and verify yourself. Responses point back to the sources that control the issue, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury regulations, revenue rulings and revenue procedures, IRS guidance, and federal case law. State and international authority is included where the question calls for it.

Common uses:

- Researching a client position before you commit to it on a return
- Checking whether recent legislation or guidance changes an answer you already relied on
- Working through cross-border and multistate questions where the authority is scattered
- Building the technical support behind a memo, a client email, or a workpaper
- Getting oriented on an issue outside your usual specialty

Because the connector runs inside ChatGPT, the research sits alongside the rest of your work. You can pull up a client email, research the question it raises, and draft the reply in one thread.

Every tool in this connector is read only. Bizora retrieves and analyzes tax authority without creating, modifying, or deleting your client records or research source material. Research usage is metered against your Bizora account credit balance.

Bizora is a research tool, not a substitute for professional judgment. Review the cited authority before relying on any answer in client work.
payload.longDescription:
Bizora 是一个 AI 原生税务研究平台。此连接器将 Bizora 的研究引擎引入 ChatGPT，让你在实际工作中提出税务问题，获得以一手权威依据为基础的答案，而非二手评论。

像向同事提问一样描述问题。Bizora 会理解问题，依据适用的权威法规进行研究，并返回有推理依据的答案和可自行打开核实的引用。回答会指向决定该问题的原始依据，包括《美国国内税收法典》、财政部法规、税收裁定与税收程序、IRS 指引，以及联邦判例法。问题需要时，也会纳入州及国际权威依据。

常见用途：

- 在纳税申报中采用某项税务处理立场前，先研究其依据
- 检查近期立法或指引是否改变了你此前依赖的答案
- 处理权威依据分散的跨境及多州税务问题
- 为备忘录、客户邮件或工作底稿建立技术依据
- 初步了解自己常规专业领域之外的问题

连接器在 ChatGPT 内运行，研究可与其他工作并行展开。你可以在同一对话中调出客户邮件、研究其中的问题，并起草回复。

此连接器的所有工具均为只读。Bizora 检索和分析税务权威依据，不会创建、修改或删除客户记录或研究原始资料。研究用量从你的 Bizora 账户积分余额中扣除。

Bizora 是研究工具，不能替代专业判断。在客户工作中依赖任何答案前，请核查所引用的权威依据。

payload.name: Belgian Annual Accounts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Annual accounts filed with the National Bank of Belgium, as structured JSON with the official rubric codes and labels in Dutch, French, German or English. Look up a Belgian company by name, fetch its balance sheet, income statement, social balance sheet and notes.
payload.longDescription: 以结构化 JSON 获取提交给比利时国家银行的年度账目，包含荷兰语、法语、德语或英语的官方报表项目代码及标签。按名称查找比利时公司，获取其资产负债表、利润表、员工与就业情况表及附注。

payload.name: Clarity AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Screen companies and portfolios against investment mandates to assess compliance. Access mandates created in the Clarity AI web app, then run compliance reports to identify breaches. Drill into individual companies for detailed evidence across a range of extra-financial metrics. Discover investment universe companies that meet your criteria, and get concise breach summaries across your portfolios, all powered by Clarity AI's data.
payload.longDescription: 根据投资授权要求筛查企业和投资组合，以评估合规情况。访问在 Clarity AI 网页应用中创建的投资授权要求，再运行合规报告以识别违规。深入查看单个企业，获取多种非财务指标的详细证据。发现投资范围内符合您条件的企业，并获得各投资组合的简明违规摘要，全部由 Clarity AI 数据支持。

payload.name: Gemini Exchange
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Gemini MCP connects ChatGPT to Gemini's exchange so you can access live market data and your account information directly.

What you can do:
Ask ChatGPT questions about market prices, trade history, order books, and other trading data. Instead of copying and pasting data or writing scripts, ChatGPT pulls the information straight from Gemini's API and answers your question.

Your account data:
You can also let ChatGPT see your balances, positions, open and past orders, and trade history. The connection is read-only — ChatGPT can see your data but can't move money or make trades. Your login credentials stay private and never get stored anywhere.
payload.longDescription:
Gemini MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接至 Gemini 交易所，让你直接访问实时市场数据及账户信息。

你可以：
向 ChatGPT 询问市场价格、交易历史、订单簿及其他交易数据。无需复制粘贴数据或编写脚本，ChatGPT 会直接从 Gemini API 获取信息并回答问题。

你的账户数据：
你也可以允许 ChatGPT 查看余额、持仓、未成交及历史订单和交易历史。连接为只读——ChatGPT 能查看数据，但不能转移资金或执行交易。登录凭据保持私密，不会存储在任何地方。

payload.name: Jawz
payload.description: 解读市场，检查投资组合
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask your AI about the market and it answers from memory: whatever it absorbed during training, with no idea what today looks like or what you actually own.

Jawz gives it both. You get a live market read and a published four-chapter process for thinking about a portfolio: See the World (what markets are doing right now), Understand the Book (what your positions are really exposed to), Decide (how to think through a specific choice), and Observe & Refine (what your past decisions actually did).

Things you can ask:
• "What's the current macro regime?"
• "What does this week's read mean for a portfolio with BTC, AAPL and GLD?"
• "Is my thesis on this position still intact?"
• "What's in this week's World Brief?"

Every answer ends with its sources and how fresh they are, so you can see exactly where each number came from and when it was last updated. The framework itself is public and versioned, with a changelog that says what changed and why, including the times it changed because it was wrong.

Jawz is free and needs no account. The market and portfolio tools work the moment you connect. An optional email sign-in exists only to remember your settings between sessions.

One thing Jawz deliberately will not do is tell you what to buy or sell. It shows what is true about the market and your positions, frames the decision, and leaves the decision to you. Jawz is information and framework, not investment advice.
payload.longDescription:

Jawz 同时提供这两方面的信息。你能获得实时市场解读，以及一套公开的四章投资组合思考流程：观察世界（市场当前在做什么）、理解组合（你的持仓实际承受哪些风险敞口）、决策（如何思考某个具体选择）、观察与改进（过去的决策实际产生了什么结果）。

你可以问：

• “我对这笔持仓的投资逻辑还成立吗？”
• “本周 World Brief 讲了什么？”

每个答案末尾都会列出来源及其时效性，便于你确切了解每个数字出自何处、最后何时更新。框架本身公开且有版本记录，变更日志说明改了什么以及原因，也包括因判断错误而修改的情况。

Jawz 免费且无需账户。连接后即可使用市场和投资组合工具。可选的邮箱登录仅用于在不同会话之间记住设置。

Jawz 明确不会告诉你买卖什么。它展示市场和持仓的事实，提供决策框架，并将决定留给你。Jawz 提供信息与框架，不提供投资建议。

payload.name: Inkle
payload.description: 访问 Inkle 财务数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your Inkle financial data, right inside ChatGPT.  Ask about your tax filings, deadlines, P&L,  invoices, bills, and cash flow- no dashboard needed. payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中访问你的 Inkle 财务数据。询问税务申报、截止日期、损益、发票、账单和现金流，无需仪表板。专为管理美国合规与记账事务的跨境初创企业创始人打造。连接器为只读，保护你的数据安全，同时让 ChatGPT 根据实时 Inkle 账户即时回答。

payload.name: Nansen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore blockchain and crypto market data with Nansen. payload.name: Tabs
payload.description: 跟踪 B2B 发票和收入
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Tabs MCP connector lets AI assistants like ChatGPT query your billing, revenue, and contract data through the Model Context Protocol. Connect your AI tools to Tabs and ask questions in natural language — no custom integration code required.
payload.longDescription: Tabs MCP 连接器让 ChatGPT 等 AI 助手通过模型上下文协议查询您的账单、收入和合同数据。将 AI 工具连接到 Tabs，用自然语言提问——无需编写自定义集成代码。

payload.name: PerilScore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PerilScore turns publicly available historical weather, disaster, and geographic data into free natural peril risk scores for any US property address. This is a similar analysis to what insurance companies perform when pricing your property policy.  Ask about an address to instantly see scores across six perils: hurricane, wildfire, flood, hail, earthquake, and tornado, plus nearest fire station proximity. No account required.
payload.longDescription: PerilScore 将公开的历史天气、灾害及地理数据转化为免费的自然灾害风险评分，适用于美国任意房产地址。这与保险公司为房产保单定价时所做的分析类似。询问地址，即可即时查看六类风险评分：飓风、山火、洪水、冰雹、地震及龙卷风，并了解与最近消防站的距离。无需账户。

payload.name: Ornn Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ornn Data gives ChatGPT live and historical market data for AI infrastructure: GPU rental price indices (spot, daily settles, rolling averages, volatility, volume, forward curve), memory (DRAM/flash/module) prices, token price indices by lab, LLM coding-activity indices, workload cost metrics, and neocloud datacenter site data. payload.name: Primary

payload.longDescription: 用于查询 Primary 财务数据的只读 MCP 服务器，包括余额、交易历史、汇率、账户及资金管理报告。不支持写入、发起转账或更改状态的操作。

payload.name: GEXLOG Market Briefings
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GEXLOG publishes a morning brief and an evening brief (plus a weekend preview) for SPX. payload.longDescription: GEXLOG 为 SPX 发布晨间和晚间简报，并提供周末前瞻。使用此插件获取简报并梳理交易时段：隔夜/实时市场情况、VIX 与期货盘面、日历事件催化因素及风险，然后查看期权结构层，包括 GEX、看跌/看涨期权墙、翻转点、预期波动和已发布的应对方案。实时工具仅获取 agent.gexlog.com 的免费报告。提供用于教育的市场结构背景，不下单，也不出售访问权限。

payload.name: Cardwell: Credit Card Picker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cardwell helps you compare a focused selection of U.S. credit cards based on what matters to you cash back, travel rewards, 0% APR, or business needs. payload.name: Donorbox

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Donorbox gives ChatGPT read-only access to the connected organization's fundraising data: org identity, donors, donations, campaigns, events, recurring plans, ticket purchases, and insights aggregations for counts, sums, trends, and rankings.

payload.name: re:cap

payload.name: PrefMark

payload.name: Pocket Runway

payload.name: OnChainDiligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inspect autonomous payment proposals against structured policy, retrieve public signed OCD receipts, and check receipt proofs. Inspection is unsigned and performs no sanctions screening. Verification returns VALID, INVALID or UNVERIFIABLE; it does not establish payment safety, compliance or service delivery. This free plugin does not execute payments, hold funds or access private operations.
payload.longDescription: 根据结构化政策检查自主付款提案，获取公开、已签名的 OCD 凭证，并检查凭证证明。检查结果不带签名，也不进行制裁筛查。验证返回 VALID、INVALID 或 UNVERIFIABLE；它不证明付款安全性、合规性或服务已交付。此免费插件不执行付款、不持有资金，也不访问私有操作。

payload.name: Balanços.AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore financial statements published by Brazilian companies. Search by company name or CNPJ, view company profiles, balance sheets and income statements, compare company rankings, and read publications with links to source documents on Balanços.AI. Financial figures are shown in Brazilian reais, with reporting periods and available data update dates. Coverage is expanding, and some periods or documents may be unavailable. A Balanços.AI account is required. Queries generate operational logs and private usage history, with usage history retained for 90 days.
payload.longDescription: 探索巴西企业公布的财务报表。在 Balanços.AI 上按企业名称或 CNPJ 搜索，查看企业资料、资产负债表和利润表，比较企业排名，并阅读附有原始文件链接的出版内容。财务数字以巴西雷亚尔表示，并显示报告期间及可用的数据更新日期。覆盖范围正在扩大，部分期间或文件可能不可用。需要 Balanços.AI 账户。查询会生成运行日志和私密使用历史，使用历史保留 90 天。

payload.name: Alpaca Live
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API. 

Connect ChatGPT to your account to monitor your live positions, analyze market trends, and manage your account using natural language. Use Alpaca’s Trading API and Dashboard directly if you want to execute your orders.

Please see the Disclosure Library at https://alpaca.markets/disclosures for additional information and disclosures from Alpaca Clearing and Alpaca Crypto.
payload.longDescription:
Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件可直接访问 Alpaca 的 Trading API 和 Market Data API。

将 ChatGPT 连接到你的账户，通过自然语言监控实时持仓、分析市场趋势并管理账户。如果要执行订单，请直接使用 Alpaca 的 Trading API 和 Dashboard。

有关 Alpaca Clearing 和 Alpaca Crypto 的更多信息及披露，请参阅 https://alpaca.markets/disclosures 的披露资料库。

payload.name: iSnapReceipts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect iSnapReceipts to search, review, and summarize your private receipt ledger. View receipt images and upload receipt photos for automatic extraction and saving in ChatGPT. Receipt logging is subject to your account limits.
payload.longDescription: 连接 iSnapReceipts，搜索、查看和汇总你的私人收据账本。在 ChatGPT 中查看收据图片并上传收据照片，自动提取信息和保存。收据记录受你的账户限额约束。

payload.name: Allstate Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a quick auto insurance estimate from Allstate by providing a few details about yourself and your vehicle. When you're ready, continue to Allstate to customize your coverage, review your quote, and purchase a policy.
payload.longDescription: 提供有关自己和车辆的一些信息，即可快速获取 Allstate 车险估算。准备好后，继续前往 Allstate 定制保障、审阅报价并购买保单。

payload.name: Nexafin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nexafin is an AI-powered personal finance and expense tracking assistant that helps you understand your spending, budget, and cash flow using natural language.

Securely connect your accounts to instantly check bank balances, review recent transactions, track recurring bills, and analyze spending by category without digging through dashboards or statements.

Nexafin is privacy-first and read-only. It cannot move money or access sensitive credentials. You stay in control of what data is shared and can disconnect at any time.

Try asking:

“Show my account balances”

“What bills are coming up?”

“How much did I spend on food last month?”

“Where is most of my money going?”
payload.longDescription:
Nexafin 是 AI 驱动的个人财务与支出追踪助手，让你用自然语言了解消费、预算和现金流。

安全连接账户后，立即查看银行余额、近期交易、经常性账单，并按类别分析支出，无需翻找面板或对账单。

Nexafin 优先保护隐私且仅提供只读访问，无法转移资金或访问敏感凭据。你始终掌控分享哪些数据，并可随时断开连接。

试着问：

“显示我的账户余额”

“接下来有哪些账单？”

“上个月我在食品上花了多少钱？”

“我的大部分钱花在哪里？”

payload.name: OnePay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to ChatGPT to OnePay to better understand your finances. View balances across Banking, Credit Card, Pay Later, Invest, Crypto and OnePay@Work. Drill into transactions by date, merchant, or category to understand your spending. Monitor your investment portfolio and crypto holdings alongside your cash. Whether you're reviewing last month's budget, analyzing a category of spending, or saving up for your next milestone. OnePay gives ChatGPT real-time access to your data so you can review your financial life in one place.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 OnePay，更好地了解财务。查看 Banking、Credit Card、Pay Later、Invest、Crypto 和 OnePay@Work 的余额。按日期、商家或类别深入查看交易，了解支出。同时监控投资组合、加密资产持仓和现金。无论是回顾上月预算、分析某类支出，还是为下一个目标储蓄，OnePay 都让 ChatGPT 实时访问数据，便于在一处查看整个财务生活。

payload.name: GrowPanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GrowPanel is a SaaS subscription-analytics platform. This connector lets ChatGPT answer real questions about your subscription business in plain language: MRR, churn (logo and MRR), retention (NRR/GRR), cohorts, MRR movements, cashflow, leads and trials, customer concentration, plans, and individual customers. Ask things like "What was my MRR churn by month this year?", "Show retention for customers who signed up in Q1", "Which plans are growing?", or "List my top customers by MRR". All figures come straight from your GrowPanel account in its base currency, and access is scoped to the signed-in user and their GrowPanel role (read-only users cannot make changes).
payload.longDescription: GrowPanel 是 SaaS 订阅分析平台。此连接器让 ChatGPT 用日常语言回答订阅业务的实际问题：MRR、流失（客户数和 MRR）、留存（NRR/GRR）、同群分析、MRR 变化、现金流、潜在客户与试用、客户集中度、套餐和单个客户。可以问：“今年每个月的 MRR 流失是多少？”“展示 Q1 注册客户的留存情况”“哪些套餐正在增长？”或“按 MRR 列出我的主要客户”。所有数字直接来自 GrowPanel 账户，使用该账户的基础货币。访问范围限于已登录用户及其 GrowPanel 角色（只读用户无法进行修改）。

payload.name: BestRemit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BestRemit helps you compare money transfer apps before sending money abroad, so you can find better-value options and keep more of your money. See transparent, side-by-side estimates for exchange rates, transfer fees, payment methods, and the amount your recipient could receive from all providers in your country. 

Providers we support: Wise, Remitly, Western Union, Xoom, Instarem, PandaRemit, LemFi, and more.
payload.longDescription:
BestRemit 帮助你在向国外汇款前比较汇款应用，寻找更划算的选择，保留更多资金。查看你所在国家所有提供商透明、并列的汇率、转账费用、支付方式和收款人可能收到金额的估算。

支持的提供商包括：Wise、Remitly、Western Union、Xoom、Instarem、PandaRemit、LemFi 等。

payload.name: DSCR Loan Calculator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze U.S. residential investment property like a DSCR lender does. OneMoreDoor Capital's DSCR Loan Calculator computes debt service coverage ratio, monthly PITIA, cash flow, cap rate, and break-even rent or price for 1-10 unit rentals, then puts a fully editable calculator right in the chat, so "what if rent were $3,900?" re-runs instantly. Continue the same deal on OneMoreDoor.com with every number carried over, or get a shareable link for your partner or broker. Investment property only; it never quotes rates, and it collects no personal information.
payload.longDescription: 像 DSCR 贷款机构一样分析美国住宅投资物业。OneMoreDoor Capital 的 DSCR Loan Calculator 为 1-10 个单元的出租物业计算偿债覆盖率、每月 PITIA、现金流、资本化率以及盈亏平衡租金或价格，并直接在聊天中展示完全可编辑的计算器，因此“如果租金是 $3,900 呢？”能立即触发重新计算。在 OneMoreDoor.com 上继续处理同一项目，所有数字都会带过去；也可获得可分享链接，发给合作伙伴或经纪人。仅用于投资物业；不提供利率报价，也不收集个人信息。

payload.name: Kalkınma Yatırım Bankası
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kalkınma Yatırım Bankası searches TKYB's public information on products, services, corporate information, financing, APEX programs, sustainability, investor relations, and contact details. It presents results in read-only information cards with links to official sources. It requires no sign-in, cannot access customer accounts, applications, transactions, or personal banking data, and provides general information only.
payload.longDescription: Kalkınma Yatırım Bankası 搜索 TKYB 有关产品、服务、企业信息、融资、APEX 项目、可持续发展、投资者关系和联系方式的公开信息。结果以只读信息卡呈现，并附官方来源链接。无需登录，不能访问客户账户、申请、交易或个人银行数据，仅提供一般信息。

payload.name: FindBroadband
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The easiest way to find the right broadband deal is now on ChatGPT.

By connecting FindBroadband with ChatGPT, you can check the broadband deals available at your exact UK address, compare live prices from the top providers and full-fibre networks and see every deal priced by its true whole-contract cost, so a teaser price never hides the real one.

Try asking ChatGPT things like:
- am I overpaying? I'm with Sky at £44 a month for 100Mb
- find me full fibre under £30 with no mid-contract price rises
- my provider quoted £43 a month to renew, is that fair?

You can refine by budget, speed, contract length or provider just by asking. Once you've found the right deal, you complete your switch on findbroadbanddeals.com.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中，现在就能轻松找到适合你的宽带方案。

将 FindBroadband 连接到 ChatGPT 后，你可以查询英国具体住址可用的宽带方案，比较主要供应商和全光纤网络的实时价格，并查看每个方案的真实全合同期费用，避免优惠宣传价掩盖实际费用。

可以试着这样问 ChatGPT：
- 我是不是付多了？我使用 Sky 的 100Mb 宽带，每月 £44
- 找一个低于 £30、合同期内不会涨价的全光纤方案
- 我的供应商续约报价是每月 £43，合理吗？

只需提出要求，即可按预算、速度、合同期限或供应商细化筛选。找到合适的方案后，在 findbroadbanddeals.com 完成服务切换。

payload.name: OptionClaws
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OptionClaws scans every optionable US stock and returns ranked options trades for the strategy you ask about.  Covered calls, cash-secured puts, credit spreads, iron condors, butterflies, calendars, diagonals, straddles, strangles, and more.

Ask in plain English, like "find me high-probability iron condors on large caps with a max loss under $500" or "show me iron condors on SPY expiring in 30–45 days," and ChatGPT will run the scan and show the top candidates with return, probability of profit, greeks, and liquidity, using quotes that refresh throughout the trading day. You can also start from a built-in preset, re-run scans you've saved on OptionClaws, and look up which filters are available before you scan.

Made for options traders who want to find and compare candidate trades without clicking through chains by hand. Requires an OptionClaws account. Results are informational only and not financial advice
payload.longDescription:
OptionClaws 扫描所有可交易期权的美国股票，并根据您询问的策略返回排名后的期权交易方案，包括备兑看涨期权、现金担保看跌期权、信用价差、铁鹰式、蝶式、日历价差、对角价差、跨式、宽跨式等。

用日常英语提问，例如“帮我找大盘股中最大亏损低于 $500 的高概率铁鹰式交易”，或“展示 30–45 天后到期的 SPY 铁鹰式交易”。ChatGPT 会运行扫描，展示最佳候选方案及其收益、盈利概率、希腊值和流动性，报价在交易日内持续更新。您还可以从内置预设开始，重新运行您保存在 OptionClaws 中的扫描，并在扫描前查询可用筛选条件。

面向希望查找并比较候选交易、无需手动逐一查看期权链的期权交易者。需要 OptionClaws 账户。结果仅供参考，不构成财务建议。

payload.name: Choice Mutual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare final expense, guaranteed acceptance, and life insurance quotes from over 25 companies to find the best policy for your needs. Most policies don't require a medical exam and have no waiting period. When you're ready to apply, you simply tap a button to start the process.

In addition to the quoting function, the assistant has access to the full Choice Mutual library of articles and resources. This means you don't have to peruse through articles trying to find the information you're looking for.

Ask anything about life or final expense insurance, policy types, pricing, or even questions about the company, and the assistant can provide clear and complete answers.
payload.longDescription:
比较超过 25 家公司的身后费用保险、保证承保保险及寿险报价，找到最适合需求的保单。大多数保单无需体检，也没有等待期。准备好申请时，只需点按按钮即可开始流程。

除报价功能外，助手还可访问 Choice Mutual 完整的文章和资源库。这意味着你无需逐篇浏览文章来寻找所需信息。

无论是寿险或身后费用保险、保单类型、价格，甚至有关公司的问题，你都可以提问，助手会提供清晰完整的回答。

payload.name: Qalimo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Qalimo est une application française de gestion locative pour bailleurs particuliers et SCI. Ce connecteur permet de piloter sa gestion locative en langage naturel : consulter ses biens, locataires, soldes, écritures comptables, transactions bancaires et documents (baux, quittances, états des lieux) ; générer les quittances de loyer et avis d'échéance en PDF ; enregistrer ou corriger des écritures comptables (loyers, charges, travaux) ; préparer les pièces d'un état des lieux. Accès limité au compte du bailleur authentifié via OAuth, en lecture et/ou écriture selon le consentement accordé.
payload.longDescription: Qalimo 是面向个人房东和 SCI（法国不动产民事公司）的法国租赁管理应用。此连接器允许用自然语言管理租赁事务：查看房产、租户、余额、会计分录、银行交易和文件（租约、租金收据、房屋交接状况记录）；生成 PDF 格式的租金收据和到期通知；录入或更正会计分录（租金、费用、工程）；准备房屋交接状况记录所需材料。访问仅限通过 OAuth 验证的房东账户，根据授予的同意范围提供读取和/或写入权限。

payload.name: Halkbank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answers your questions about Halkbank's retail, commercial, and SME banking products and services based on the content of the bank's official websites, citing its sources. You can get information in Turkish or English on a wide range of topics, from loans to cards, from Paraf to ParafLy Travel. It cannot access personal data or account information, and cannot perform customer-specific transactions.
payload.longDescription: 依据 Halkbank 官方网站的内容回答有关零售、商业和中小企业银行产品与服务的问题，并引用来源。你可以用土耳其语或英语获取从贷款到银行卡、从 Paraf 到 ParafLy Travel 等广泛主题的信息。它不能访问个人数据或账户信息，也不能执行针对具体客户的交易。

payload.name: MONVELOP
payload.description: 探索你的 MONVELOP 预算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your MONVELOP account to understand your personal budget in conversation. Ask for a monthly financial overview, a spending breakdown by envelope, recent transactions, recurring subscriptions, or a comparison between budget periods.

MONVELOP tools are read-only. They cannot create, edit, or delete financial data, initiate payments or transfers, connect a bank, or execute investments. Results are limited to your authenticated MONVELOP account and the permissions you approve.
payload.longDescription:
连接 MONVELOP 账户，通过对话了解个人预算。请求月度财务概览、按预算信封分类的支出明细、近期交易、定期订阅，或不同预算期间的比较。

MONVELOP 工具为只读，不能创建、编辑或删除财务数据，不能发起付款或转账、连接银行，或执行投资。结果仅限你已验证身份的 MONVELOP 账户，以及你批准的权限范围。

payload.name: Rydoo
payload.description: 管理你的 Rydoo 费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rydoo MCP connects ChatGPT to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — ChatGPT can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.

Key features:
- Read and analyse spend — search expenses you own or oversee by date, status, category, group, person or trip, pull up a single expense with a link into Rydoo, find card expenses still missing a receipt, and get server-computed totals per trip, person or project.
- Process approvals — see what's waiting on you, then approve or reject an expense using your company's reject reasons. Every action is confirmed with you first and recorded under your name.
- Answer questions — expense-policy Q&A: what's reimbursable, which limits apply, and similar.
- Look up company records — find the right category, branch, group, person or trip to filter expenses by, and check your own roles, modules and currencies.
- Review trips — look up trips and bookings you own or oversee, and tie expenses back to them.
- Manage cards and wallets — list cards you hold, approve or oversee as finance, review matched and unmatched card transactions, check wallet balances, spend summaries and monthly statements, and request a virtual card with the limit you confirm. Requires the Rydoo Cards module.
- Send feedback — report a bug or request a feature straight to Rydoo.
payload.longDescription:
Rydoo MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Rydoo 账户，让你通过日常对话管理费用，无需在应用中逐项操作。使用现有 Rydoo 登录信息登录一次即可——此后，ChatGPT 只能按照你自己的角色和权限，查看和执行你在 Rydoo 中已获准访问和执行的内容。

主要功能：
- 查看和分析支出——按日期、状态、类别、群组、人员或行程搜索你本人或你负责监管的费用；调出单笔费用及其 Rydoo 链接；查找仍缺少收据的卡片费用；获取服务器计算的各行程、人员或项目合计。
- 处理审批——查看等待你处理的事项，随后使用公司的拒绝原因批准或拒绝费用。每项操作都会先征求你的确认，并以你的名义记录。
- 回答问题——解答费用政策问题，例如哪些费用可报销、适用哪些限额等。
- 查询公司记录——查找适合筛选费用的类别、分支机构、群组、人员或行程，并检查自己的角色、模块和货币。
- 查看行程——查询你本人或你负责监管的行程及预订，并将费用关联到这些行程。
- 管理卡片和钱包——列出你持有、审批或以财务身份监管的卡片；查看已匹配和未匹配的卡片交易；检查钱包余额、支出摘要和月度账单；按你确认的额度申请虚拟卡。需要启用 Rydoo Cards 模块。
- 提交反馈——直接向 Rydoo 报告问题或提出功能需求。

payload.name: Validis (UK)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardised general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.

payload.name: Validis (AU)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardised general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.

payload.name: Gate Info
payload.description: 加密货币市场研究数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gate Info provides public, read-only cryptocurrency research data for ChatGPT: coin profiles, market overview and spot snapshots (including batch), Gate candlesticks, order book depth, and recent trades across spot, futures, delivery, and options where supported. No login, no account balances, no order placement or fund transfers. Data is informational only and is not investment advice. News/social tools are on Gate News; documentation tools are on a separate MCP server. Production MCP URL: https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/open/info (Streamable HTTP, no auth).
payload.longDescription: Gate Info 为 ChatGPT 提供公开、只读的加密货币研究数据：币种概况、市场总览和现货快照（含批量查询）、Gate K 线、订单簿深度，以及在支持情况下覆盖现货、永续期货、交割合约和期权的近期交易。无需登录，不访问账户余额，不下单或转移资金。数据仅供参考，不构成投资建议。新闻/社交工具位于 Gate News；文档工具位于独立的 MCP 服务器。生产 MCP URL：https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/open/info（Streamable HTTP，无需身份验证）。

payload.name: Midpoint Card Prices
payload.description: 集换式及体育卡牌价格与回报率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up what a trading card is worth and whether grading it pays. Midpoint returns current USD market prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Gundam, sports (baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, wrestling, UFC, golf, tennis, boxing, racing) and entertainment cards. Ask for a card by name, set or number to get its raw (ungraded) price by condition and the graded ladder for PSA, CGC, BGS, SGC and TAG. Ask whether it is worth grading to get the PSA 9 and PSA 10 premium, net profit after grading fees, expected value by gem rate and a plain verdict. You can also see 7 to 180 days of price history, the biggest 30-day movers, rising cards that actually sell, the best cards to grade in a game or set, and priced set checklists. Every answer links to the matching page on cardcenteringtool.com. No account is needed and nothing is written.
payload.longDescription: 查询一张集换式卡牌值多少钱，以及送评评级是否划算。Midpoint 提供 1.5M+ 张 Pokémon、Magic: The Gathering、Yu-Gi-Oh!、One Piece、Lorcana、Gundam、体育（棒球、篮球、美式橄榄球、冰球、足球、摔跤、UFC、高尔夫、网球、拳击、赛车）和娱乐卡牌的当前美元市场价格。按名称、系列或编号查询卡牌，可获得按品相区分的未评级裸卡价格，以及 PSA、CGC、BGS、SGC 和 TAG 的各评级档价格。询问是否值得评级，可获取 PSA 9 和 PSA 10 的溢价、扣除评级费后的净利润、按高分评级概率计算的期望价值，以及直白的结论。还可查看 7 至 180 天价格历史、30 天内涨跌幅最大的卡牌、真正有成交的上涨卡牌、某游戏或系列中最值得评级的卡牌，以及标注价格的系列清单。每个回答都链接至 cardcenteringtool.com 上的对应页面。无需账户，不会写入任何内容。

payload.name: Mergr
payload.description: 查找私募股权公司、交易与买家
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mergr is a private equity and M&A research database, now available in ChatGPT. It covers 4,100+ active PE firms, 224,000+ companies, and 223,000+ transactions, with ownership histories, deal advisors, and 100,000+ press releases, focused on the middle market.

Ask the questions you'd put to an analyst: which PE firms would buy a $30M revenue HVAC company in Texas; who has owned a company and for how long; which sponsors are building roll-ups in a sector; which banks advised the most software deals last year. You can also paste a list of company names or websites and match them to Mergr records in one step.

Twelve read-only tools cover firm, company, and deal search; buyer, investor, and advisor matching; ownership histories; activity rankings; and roll-up tracking. Every result links to the corresponding mergr.com profile. Access requires a mergr.com membership.
payload.longDescription:
Mergr 是私募股权和并购研究数据库，现在可在 ChatGPT 中使用。它聚焦中型企业市场，覆盖 4,100+ 家活跃私募股权公司、224,000+ 家公司和 223,000+ 笔交易，包含所有权历史、交易顾问和 100,000+ 篇新闻稿。

像向分析师一样提问：哪些私募股权公司会收购得克萨斯州一家营收 $30M 的暖通空调企业；谁曾拥有某家公司、持有多久；哪些投资方正在某行业进行整合收购；去年哪些银行参与顾问的软件交易最多。你还可粘贴公司名称或网站列表，一步匹配 Mergr 记录。

十二个只读工具覆盖投资机构、公司和交易搜索，买家、投资者和顾问匹配，所有权历史，活动排名，以及整合收购追踪。每项结果都链接到对应的 mergr.com 资料页。访问需要 mergr.com 会员资格。

payload.name: Comparador de seguros BuenaIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read-only BuenaIA prototype that searches, details, and compares a catalog reconstructed from publicly available commercial product sheets (mobile, devices, home, business cyber, and digital protection). It helps identify coverage, overlaps, gaps, and profile fit, and links to the official pricing tool. It is not a Telefónica or Movistar sales channel, does not issue policies, and does not calculate personalized premiums.
payload.longDescription: BuenaIA 的只读原型，可搜索、查看详情和比较根据公开商业产品说明书重建的目录，涵盖手机、设备、家庭、企业网络安全和数字保护。它帮助识别保障范围、重叠、缺口及与个人情况的匹配程度，并提供官方定价工具链接。它不是 Telefónica 或 Movistar 的销售渠道，不签发保单，也不计算个性化保费。

payload.name: Calculadora de Autônomos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Calculadora de Autônomos - Contabilizei.
Descubra como a Reforma Tributária pode impactar empresas que contratam autônomos e profissionais que trabalham por conta própria. Simule custos, compare cenários e entenda as mudanças tributárias de acordo com o seu perfil. Para as empresas, descubra qual é o custo de tempo e dinheiro na contratação de autônomos. Para quem trabalha por conta própria, veja como diferentes formas de atuação podem afetar seus custos e obrigações e entenda qual é a mais econômica.
payload.longDescription:
自由职业者计算器 - Contabilizei。
了解税制改革如何影响雇用自由职业者的企业及自雇专业人士。模拟成本、比较情景，并根据您的情况理解税务变化。对于企业，了解雇用自由职业者所需的时间和金钱成本。对于自雇者，了解不同工作形式如何影响成本和义务，并找出最经济的方式。

payload.name: Thrifle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask about any US retailer's return policy: the return window, whether returns are free, restocking fees, holiday extensions, and a grade from A+ to D-. Check whether a store price-matches, what military and student discounts it offers, what a brand gives away on your birthday, and how to cancel a subscription. Find live deals with prices and list prices, look up store credit-card terms including deferred-interest promotions, and ask whether an Amazon price is worth buying now or waiting on. Every answer includes a link to the Thrifle page it is based on. The data covers 2,250 US retailers, is verified by Thrifle's editors, and each record carries the date it was last checked. The plugin is read-only: it looks things up and never changes anything.

payload.name: Alvore Finance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alvore Finance is the workspace where financial consultants and their business clients keep the numbers an engagement runs on. With this app you can ask about a company's P&L, indicators, budget and categorized transactions for any month; review an individual client's overview, household budget and transactions; and read the consulting deliverables attached to each engagement, or publish a new one. Reads cover company and personal finance. Writes only create or update project content — a project, its briefing, an HTML deliverable and its versions — inside the client's private workspace. No tool initiates or settles a payment, transfer or purchase, and nothing the app writes is published to a public address.
payload.longDescription: Alvore Finance 是财务顾问及其企业客户保存咨询项目所需财务数字的工作空间。通过此应用，您可查询企业任意月份的损益表、指标、预算和分类交易；查看个人客户概况、家庭预算和交易；阅读各咨询项目附带的交付成果，或发布新的成果。读取范围涵盖企业和个人财务。写入操作仅在客户的私密工作空间内创建或更新项目内容，包括项目、项目简报、HTML 交付成果及其版本。没有任何工具会发起或结算付款、转账或购买，应用写入的任何内容也不会发布至公开地址。

payload.name: The Kingdom Bank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your TKB account to ChatGPT and get instant answers about your invoices — amounts, due dates, statuses and payment details — without logging into the portal.

payload.name: Análise de FIIs
payload.description: 巴西房地产投资基金研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research and track Brazilian REITs (real estate investment funds, or FIIs) using natural language. Análise de FIIs organizes fund prices, dividend yield, fundamentals, indicators, risk, liquidity, distributions, and reports. Compare funds and use a screener to find FIIs that match your criteria. Authenticated Pro users can also track their own portfolios, including holdings, dividends, valuations, and processing status. The free preview provides public fund data and indicators, while Pro unlocks the remaining tools and full analyses. The app is informational and read-only: it does not buy or sell investments, move money, or replace financial advice.
payload.longDescription: 通过自然语言研究和跟踪巴西 REITs（房地产投资基金，即 FIIs）。Análise de FIIs 整理基金价格、股息率、基本面、指标、风险、流动性、分配和报告。比较基金，并使用筛选器寻找符合条件的 FIIs。已认证的 Pro 用户还可以跟踪自己的投资组合，包括持有资产、股息、估值和处理状态。免费预览提供公开基金数据和指标，Pro 则解锁其余工具和完整分析。该应用仅供信息参考且为只读：不买卖投资、不转移资金，也不能替代财务建议。

payload.name: MetLife Pet Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore MetLife Pet Insurance through a simple, guided conversation designed to make pet insurance easier to understand. Share a few details about your dog or cat and quickly explore coverage options tailored to your pet.

Review available plan details and pricing. Whether you’re welcoming a new pet or looking for coverage for a longtime companion, the app helps you understand your options and get a personalized quote.

When you’re ready, continue with MetLife Pet Insurance to complete the next steps. Coverage, pricing, eligibility, and policy terms may vary. Chat responses may contain inaccuracies. Users should verify coverage, pricing, eligibility, and policy terms on MetLife’s website before enrollment.
payload.longDescription:
通过简单的引导式对话了解 MetLife Pet Insurance，让宠物保险更易理解。分享有关你的狗或猫的少量信息，即可快速探索适合宠物的保障选项。

查看可用方案的详情和价格。无论你是在迎接新宠物，还是为陪伴多年的伙伴寻找保障，应用都能帮助你理解选项并获得个性化报价。

准备好后，可继续前往 MetLife Pet Insurance 完成后续步骤。保障、价格、资格和保单条款可能有所不同。聊天回答可能存在不准确之处。投保前，用户应在 MetLife 网站上核实保障、价格、资格和保单条款。

payload.name: QuoteScore
payload.description: 检查维修报价是否合理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QuoteScore scores a contractor, home service or auto repair quote for pricing fairness. Paste the line items and it returns a 0 to 100 score, the fair market range for each line, and the specific problems named: a lump sum with no breakdown, labor billed past standard book time, parts marked well above retail, or an inflated shop supplies fee.

Scoring runs against roughly 14,700 regional pricing benchmarks and an archive of thousands of real quotes that people submitted to be checked, so the answer is grounded in observed prices rather than estimated. The aggregate dataset is published openly under CC BY 4.0.

Free, and no account or sign in is required. It checks price, not workmanship: it cannot tell you whether a contractor does good work, only whether the number is normal.
payload.longDescription:
QuoteScore 评估承包商、家庭服务或汽车维修报价的价格公平性。粘贴报价明细，它会返回 0 至 100 分评分、每项的合理市场价格区间，并指出具体问题：没有明细的总价、超出标准工时的人工费、远高于零售价的零件加价，或虚高的车间耗材费。

评分依据约 14,700 个地区定价基准，以及人们提交核查的数千份真实报价档案，因此答案建立在实际观察到的价格而非估算上。汇总数据集依据 CC BY 4.0 公开发布。

免费，无需账户或登录。它检查价格，不评估施工质量：它无法告诉您承包商的工作是否出色，只能判断报价数字是否正常。

payload.name: Candor Finance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Candor is your financial workspace for budgets, goals, recurring bills, and the decisions you want to keep. Connect your accounts on Candor, then use ChatGPT to review your finances with the records and context in one place.

Ask what changed since your last review, inspect a price increase, find a refund worth following up on, or compare spending with your budget. View cash flow, spending, budget, and recurring-payment panels. Organize transactions, confirm recurring bills, update budgets and goals, and save notes linked to the supporting records.

Candor calculates figures from your records and keeps your approved plans, notes, and action history across conversations and compatible agents. ChatGPT helps you interpret the information and decide what to do.

Requires an existing Candor account with active access. Financial accounts are connected on Candor's website. Financial-source access is read-only. Candor does not transfer money or execute investment trades.
payload.longDescription:
Candor 是用于管理预算、目标、定期账单，以及你希望保留的决策的财务工作空间。在 Candor 连接账户后，即可用 ChatGPT 在一处结合记录与上下文审视财务状况。

询问自上次回顾以来有哪些变化，检查涨价，查找值得跟进的退款，或比较支出与预算。查看现金流、支出、预算及定期付款面板。整理交易、确认定期账单、更新预算与目标，并保存关联支持记录的笔记。

Candor 根据你的记录计算数值，并在不同对话及兼容智能体之间保留已批准的计划、笔记和操作历史。ChatGPT 帮助你解读信息并决定行动。

需要已有且具有有效访问权限的 Candor 账户。金融账户在 Candor 网站上连接。对金融数据源的访问为只读。Candor 不会转账，也不会执行投资交易。

payload.name: Validis (US)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardized general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.

payload.name: Testfolio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Testfolio connects an eligible Testfolio account to portfolio research in ChatGPT. Backtest and compare portfolios, analyze assets, optimize allocations, evaluate tactical strategies and signals, and study retirement withdrawals, Monte Carlo scenarios, leveraged ETFs, factors, and principal components. Results explain the effective data period, assumptions, ticker provenance, key metrics, and compact summaries of large datasets. Analysis calls record account usage and may consume analysis credits. Users can explicitly create a public configuration link after a successful supported analysis. Testfolio supports historical, simulated, and hypothetical research; it does not execute trades or move money. Access requires Testfolio Max or a separate MCP grant, with tools subject to the connected account's limits.

payload.name: Revestor
payload.description: 出租账目和 REPS 工时
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Revestor is rental portfolio and tax-readiness software for U.S. landlords. Connect it to query live Revestor records after OAuth consent, including properties, REPS hours, expenses, and mileage. With write access, assistants can propose time logs, mileage, or unclassified expenses; proposals stay pending in Revestor AI Review until you accept them. Connector traffic does not use Gemini or Revestor AI credits. Output is records and status only, not tax, legal, or accounting advice.
payload.longDescription: Revestor 是面向美国房东的出租物业组合和税务准备软件。通过 OAuth 授权后，连接它即可查询实时 Revestor 记录，包括房产、房地产专业人士资格（REPS）工时、费用和里程。获得写入权限后，助手可提出工时记录、里程或未分类费用的建议；这些建议会留在 Revestor AI Review 中等待处理，直到您接受。连接器流量不会使用 Gemini 或 Revestor AI 积分。输出仅为记录和状态，不构成税务、法律或会计建议。

payload.name: Kintsugi AI
payload.description: 自动处理销售税与增值税
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kintsugi is an AI-powered platform that automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for SaaS and ecommerce businesses, and financial firms. The Kintsugi MCP server lets you track your compliance without leaving the conversation.

With the Kintsugi MCP server, you can:

See your nexus exposure in real time, for free, across every jurisdiction where you sell

Look up registrations and jurisdiction-specific requirements

Estimate sales tax, VAT, and GST for a transaction, address, or product

Check on the status of your filings, for all jurisdictions

Look up customer records, transactions, and exemption certificates

Look up your product catalog and product tax categories

This MCP server informs your decisions rather than acting on your behalf: it doesn't file a return, register you in a new jurisdiction, or change any settings. 

Built for finance, accounting, and operations teams who need fast, accurate answers about their compliance status, whether that's confirming a nexus threshold, checking a customer's exemption history, or estimating tax on a new deal.
payload.longDescription:
Kintsugi 是一个由 AI 驱动的平台，为 SaaS、电商企业及金融机构自动处理销售税、VAT 和 GST 合规。Kintsugi MCP 服务器让你无需离开对话即可跟踪合规情况。

通过 Kintsugi MCP 服务器，你可以：

免费实时查看你开展销售的各司法辖区中的纳税关联风险

查询税务登记和各司法辖区的特定要求

估算某笔交易、某个地址或某种产品的销售税、VAT 和 GST

查看所有司法辖区的申报状态

查询客户记录、交易及免税证明

查询产品目录和产品税务类别

此 MCP 服务器为决策提供信息，不会代你采取行动：它不会提交纳税申报、在新司法辖区为你登记，或更改任何设置。

专为财务、会计及运营团队打造，快速准确回答合规状态问题，无论是确认纳税关联门槛、核查客户免税历史，还是估算新交易的税额。

payload.name: Thimble Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get real-time commercial insurance quotes, compare coverage options, and streamline underwriting workflows with Thimble. Designed for brokers, agencies, and embedded insurance experiences.
